label: FP
reason: User-supplied Referer header is read, URL-decoded, then passed to ESAPI.encoder().encodeForHTML() which encodes HTML special characters. The encoded result is written to the HTTP response body. Since XSS requires unencoded script tags in the context of HTML content, proper HTML encoding neutralizes the attack vector.

evidence.note: Input from Referer header flows through URL decoding and then HTML encoding via ESAPI before being written to response
